## Notes

Maxis, 1990, designed by Will Wright and Fred Haslam; James Lovelock advised and his Gaia hypothesis shaped the models; atmospheric gas percentages, warming melts ice caps and raises seas, volcanic dust cools; Daisyworld mode; Mars and Venus terraforming scenarios; actions cost energy.
